content.title: Why Lemonade (LMND) Stock Is Up Today
content.summary: Shares of digital insurance provider Lemonade (NYSE:LMND) jumped 4.8% in the afternoon session after JMP analyst Matthew Carletti raised the price target for the company, projecting a significant market share increase and sustainable growth. This optimistic outlook from the analyst helped propel the stock to a new 52-week high. Morgan Stanley also adjusted its target for Lemonade, though it maintained a more cautious view.
